```bash
python3 - << 'PY'
import re
text=open("specs/001-support-ticket-system/tasks.md").read().splitlines()
ids=[]
bad=[]
pat=re.compile(r"^- \[ \] (T\d{3})( \[P\])?( \[(US\d+)\])? .+")
for i,line in enumerate(text,1):
    if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
        m=pat.match(line)
        if not m:
            bad.append((i,line))
        else:
            ids.append(m.group(1))
            # file path heuristic: contains a path-like token
            if not re.search(r"`[^`]+\.[a-z0-9]+`", line) and not re.search(r"`[^`]+/`", line) and "compose.yaml" not in line and "quickstart.md" not in line and "spec.md" not in line and "openapi.yaml" not in line:
                bad.append((i,"NO PATH "+line[:120]))
nums=[int(x[1:]) for x in ids]
print("count", len(ids))
print("first", ids[0], "last", ids[-1])
print("gaps", [n for n in range(nums[0], nums[-1]+1) if n not in nums])
print("dups", [x for x in ids if ids.count(x)>1])
print("bad", len(bad))
for b in bad:
    print(b[0], b[1][:200])
from collections import Counter
stories=Counter()
for line in text:
    m=re.search(r"\[US(\d+)\]", line)
    if m and line.startswith("- [ ]"):
        stories[f"US{m.group(1)}"]+=1
print(dict(stories))
setup=sum(1 for line in text if line.startswith("- [ ] T00") and "[US" not in line and int(re.search(r"T(\d+)", line).group(1))<=4)
print("setup lines checked via ids")
# phase ranges
print("setup", sum(1 for n in nums if n<=4))
print("found", sum(1 for n in nums if 5<=n<=15))
print("polish", sum(1 for n in nums if n>=73))
```
